scope: D95-04 complete-pack Hub editing; verified exact CI artifact deployed only to the existing isolated preview

implementation.complete_pack: Open, validate, edit and save all original payload files, captured artifacts and initial receipts; preserve unknown bytes and reject missing/changed referenced artifacts
implementation.receipt: Initial capture receipt stays unchanged and does not endorse later edits
implementation.races: Late file-open or save completion cannot replace newer edits or mark them saved
implementation.data_boundary: Private records remain in the user browser; no hosted private-instance store or telemetry

validation.real_python_hub_sdk_exchange: Capture binary originals in Python, edit through Hub, reopen with SDK and Python after original deletion; passed
validation.browser_scope: Chromium desktop and phone-size WebKit downloads, attachment edit/reopen offline, accessibility and overflow
validation.live_browser: Hosted workbench opened, new Research created and structural validation passed; synthetic data only

artifact.ci_build_note: GitHub pull-request test merge; full tree verified equal to the tested PR head
artifact.local_verification: Downloaded archive digest, module digest and all asset hashes verified before deployment; no locally rebuilt substitute

post_deployment_health.rerun_note: First run correctly failed before new release deployment; rerun passed after deployment

result.scope: public availability and exact release bytes; no user-record data
